steps.command: for f in /app/logs/*.log; do echo "=== $f ==="; head -5 "$f"; done | head -80

ls /app/logs | sed 's/_[^_]*\.log$//' | sort -u | head -5; echo "..."; ls /app/logs | sed 's/_[^_]*\.log$//' | sort -u | tail -5; echo "---severities---"; grep -oh '\[[A-Z]*\]' /app/logs/*.log | sort | uniq -c; echo "---lines not matching---"; grep -vhE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} \[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG)\]' /app/logs/*.log | head -20

echo "--- line date vs filename mismatches ---"; for f in /app/logs/*.log; do fn=$(basename "$f" | cut -c1-10); bad=$(grep -vc "^$fn " "$f"); [ "$bad" -gt 0 ] && echo "$f: $bad mismatched"; done | head -20; echo "--- total lines ---"; cat /app/logs/*.log | wc -l

cd /app/logs
compute() {
  local start=$1 end=$2 label=$3
  for sev in ERROR WARNING INFO; do
    c=$(awk -v s="$start" -v e="$end" -v sev="[$sev]" '
      { d=substr($1,1,10); if (d>=s && d<=e && $3==sev) n++ }
      END{print n+0}' *.log)
    echo "$label,$sev,$c"
  done
}
{
echo "period,severity,count"
compute 2025-08-12 2025-08-12 today
compute 2025-08-06 2025-08-12 last_7_days
compute 2025-07-14 2025-08-12 last_30_days
compute 2025-08-01 2025-08-12 month_to_date
compute 0000-00-00 9999-99-99 total
} > /app/summary.csv
cat /app/summary.csv

cd /app/logs; echo "verify last_7_days:"; grep -hE '^2025-08-(0[6-9]|1[0-2]) ' *.log | grep -oE '\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]' | sort | uniq -c; echo "verify month_to_date ERROR:"; grep -hE '^2025-08-(0[1-9]|1[0-2]) ' *.log | grep -c '\[ERROR\]'; echo "--- file ---"; ls -l /app/summary.csv
